limitations: Purposeful Atlantic tropical-cyclone pilot, not a representative extreme-weather population.
Storm identities, advisory numbers and event splits are fixed before this acquisition.
Advisory number does not imply equal storm intensity, landfall phase or severity across events.
Failed downloads and parser rejections remain in the planned denominator without replacement.
Development and heldout mean event-group assignments; no claim of training-data decontamination.
Historical public availability is not established by issue or current retrieval times.

extraction: Python html.parser.HTMLParser(convert_charrefs=True), concatenate data inside the sole pre element; UTF-8 encode without whitespace normalization. Original HTML retained. Retrieval time does not establish historical publication time.
